description: Typestate FSM preset collection. Each machine defines states (nodes), transitions (edges), an initial state, and accepting/final states.

schema.node: { id: string, name: string, x: number, y: number }
schema.edge: { id: string, from: string (node id), to: string (node id), event: string }
schema.machine: { label, category, description, nodes[], edges[], initialStateId, finalStateIds[] }

trafficLight.label: Traffic Light
trafficLight.description: Cyclic three-state machine. No terminal state. Models any periodic process driven by a single recurring event.

fetchLifecycle.label: Fetch Lifecycle
fetchLifecycle.description: Async data fetching pattern: idle, loading, success, error with retry. The canonical useReducer example.

turnstile.label: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Two-state machine with self-loops. The textbook introductory FSM. Demonstrates no-op transitions as explicit self-loops.

regexAB.label: Regex (ends in 'ab')
regexAB.description: DFA accepting strings over {a,b} ending with 'ab'. Equivalent to regex (a|b)*ab. Demonstrates regex-FSM equivalence.

vendingMachine.label: Vending Machine
vendingMachine.description: Transactional process with branching (select vs cancel) and convergence (both paths return to idle).

tcpConnection.label: TCP Connection
tcpConnection.description: Simplified TCP state diagram (RFC 793). 9 states, 11 transitions. A real-world complex protocol FSM.

ifrs17_contractLifecycle.label: IFRS 17: Contract Lifecycle
ifrs17_contractLifecycle.description: Insurance contract lifecycle under IFRS 17. Tracks a contract from initial recognition through measurement periods to derecognition on settlement, expiry, or transfer.

ifrs17_classification.label: IFRS 17: Measurement Model
ifrs17_classification.description: Contract group classification into GMM (General Measurement Model), VFA (Variable Fee Approach), or PAA (Premium Allocation Approach) based on contract characteristics.

ifrs17_csmTracking.label: IFRS 17: CSM / Loss Component
ifrs17_csmTracking.description: Tracks whether a contract group is profitable (positive CSM) or onerous (loss component recognized). CSM absorbs favourable/unfavourable changes; when depleted, a loss is recognized in P&L.

ifrs9_eclStaging.label: IFRS 9: ECL Staging
ifrs9_eclStaging.description: Expected Credit Loss staging under IFRS 9. Stage 1 (12-month ECL), Stage 2 (lifetime ECL, performing), Stage 3 (lifetime ECL, credit-impaired). Instruments move between stages based on credit risk changes.

ifrs9_classification.label: IFRS 9: Asset Classification
ifrs9_classification.description: Financial asset classification under IFRS 9. Two tests: SPPI (solely payments of principal and interest) and Business Model. Determines measurement basis: amortized cost, FVOCI, or FVTPL.

ifrs9_hedgeAccounting.label: IFRS 9: Hedge Accounting
ifrs9_hedgeAccounting.description: Hedge accounting lifecycle: designation, effectiveness testing, rebalancing, and discontinuation. A hedge relationship must meet qualifying criteria continuously.

sc_orderFulfillment.label: Order Fulfillment
sc_orderFulfillment.description: End-to-end order lifecycle from placement through picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Includes return path for reverse logistics.

sc_inventoryMgmt.label: Inventory Management
sc_inventoryMgmt.description: Inventory lifecycle with reorder point logic. Tracks stock levels through depletion, reorder triggers, procurement, and replenishment. Includes stockout as a failure state.

sc_qualityControl.label: Quality Control
sc_qualityControl.description: Incoming goods inspection process. Items are inspected, passed or failed, sent to rework or scrap, and released to inventory only after passing.

sc_shipmentTracking.label: Shipment Tracking
sc_shipmentTracking.description: Parcel tracking from booking through hub transfers to last-mile delivery. Includes exception handling for lost or damaged shipments.

bayes_inference.label: Bayesian Inference Pipeline
bayes_inference.description: The Bayesian inference workflow: specify a prior, collect data, compute the likelihood, update to the posterior, check convergence, and iterate. The cycle from posterior back to data collection represents sequential updating.

bayes_modelSelection.label: Bayesian Model Selection
bayes_modelSelection.description: Model comparison workflow using information criteria (WAIC, LOO-CV). Fit candidate models, compute criteria, compare, select the best, and validate with posterior predictive checks.

bayes_abTesting.label: Bayesian A/B Testing
bayes_abTesting.description: Bayesian approach to A/B testing with optional early stopping. Unlike frequentist testing, the posterior probability of a winner can be checked continuously without inflating error rates.

mcmc_metropolisHastings.label: Metropolis-Hastings
mcmc_metropolisHastings.description: The core MCMC loop: propose a new point from the proposal distribution, compute the acceptance ratio, accept or reject, record the sample, and repeat. The accept/reject step is the key mechanism that ensures the chain converges to the target distribution.

mcmc_convergence.label: MCMC Convergence
mcmc_convergence.description: MCMC chain lifecycle from warmup through burn-in discard to productive sampling. Convergence diagnostics (R-hat, ESS) determine whether the chain has mixed and whether more samples are needed.

mcmc_gibbs.label: Gibbs Sampler
mcmc_gibbs.description: Gibbs sampling cycles through parameters, sampling each from its full conditional distribution while holding the others fixed. The cycle is the characteristic structure: theta1, theta2, theta3, record, repeat.

compiler_pipeline.label: Compilation Pipeline
compiler_pipeline.description: Multi-phase compiler pipeline: lexical analysis, parsing, type checking, optimization, and code generation. Each phase can fail, producing diagnostics.

compiler_lexer.label: Lexer States
compiler_lexer.description: Lexer (tokenizer) state machine. Reads characters and transitions between modes: identifier, number, string literal, comment. Each accepting state emits a token.

compiler_gc.label: Garbage Collector (Mark-Sweep)
compiler_gc.description: Mark-and-sweep garbage collection cycle. The mutator runs, allocation triggers GC, roots are scanned, the heap is marked, unreachable objects are swept, and the mutator resumes.

compiler_shiftReduce.label: Shift-Reduce Parser
compiler_shiftReduce.description: Bottom-up (LR) parser actions: shift pushes a token onto the stack, reduce applies a grammar rule, accept terminates on valid input, error on invalid input. Conflicts (shift-reduce, reduce-reduce) indicate grammar ambiguity.

cicd_pipeline.label: CI/CD Pipeline
cicd_pipeline.description: Continuous integration and deployment pipeline. Commit triggers build, which triggers test, which gates deployment. Failures at any stage halt the pipeline. Rollback from production returns to a stable state.

reason_forwardChain.label: Forward Chaining
reason_forwardChain.description: Data-driven inference: assert facts into working memory, match rules against facts (pattern matching), resolve conflicts among matched rules, fire the highest-priority rule, derive new facts, repeat until fixpoint (no new facts derivable).

reason_backwardChain.label: Backward Chaining
reason_backwardChain.description: Goal-driven inference: set a goal, search for rules whose conclusion matches the goal, check if premises are known facts, if not recurse on each premise as a sub-goal, succeed or fail with backtracking.

reason_rete.label: Rete Network
reason_rete.description: Rete algorithm for efficient rule matching: facts enter the alpha network (single-condition tests), pass to the beta network (join conditions across rules), matched rule instantiations enter the conflict set, selected rule fires. Incremental -- only re-evaluates affected rules on fact changes.

reason_descriptionLogic.label: Description Logic Reasoner
reason_descriptionLogic.description: OWL/DL reasoner: load TBox (terminology) and ABox (assertions), classify the concept hierarchy, realize individuals, check consistency. Open-world assumption -- absence of a fact does not imply its negation.

reason_tms.label: Truth Maintenance System
reason_tms.description: JTMS/ATMS: beliefs are justified by support sets. When a justification is retracted, all beliefs depending on it are retracted (dependency-directed backtracking). Maintains consistency without re-deriving from scratch.

reason_constraintProp.label: Constraint Propagation
reason_constraintProp.description: Arc consistency (AC-3): maintain variable domains, propagate constraints to prune domains, detect domain wipeout (failure), backtrack and search. Used in CSP solvers, scheduling, and configuration.

reason_satSmt.label: SAT/SMT Solver (CDCL)
reason_satSmt.description: Conflict-Driven Clause Learning: unit propagation (BCP), decide (pick an unassigned variable), detect conflict, analyze conflict to learn a clause, backjump to the appropriate decision level, repeat until SAT or UNSAT.

ifrs17_reinsurance.label: IFRS 17: Reinsurance Held
ifrs17_reinsurance.description: Reinsurance contract from ceding company perspective. Mirrors direct insurance lifecycle but with net cost recovery logic and different gain/loss recognition timing.

ifrs17_investmentComponent.label: IFRS 17: Investment Component
ifrs17_investmentComponent.description: Determining whether a contract has a distinct investment component that must be separated. If distinct, it is excluded from insurance revenue and measured under IFRS 9.

ifrs17_riskAdjustment.label: IFRS 17: Risk Adjustment
ifrs17_riskAdjustment.description: The risk adjustment for non-financial risk compensates for uncertainty in cash flows. Computed each period, released as risk expires, and re-estimated on new information.

ifrs17_transition.label: IFRS 17: Transition Approaches
ifrs17_transition.description: First-time adoption of IFRS 17: choose between full retrospective (ideal but often impracticable), modified retrospective, or fair value approach.

ifrs17_contractBoundary.label: IFRS 17: Contract Boundary
ifrs17_contractBoundary.description: Determining which future cash flows belong within the contract boundary. Cash flows outside the boundary are treated as future contracts.

ifrs17_revenueRecog.label: IFRS 17: Revenue Recognition
ifrs17_revenueRecog.description: Insurance revenue is recognized as coverage units are provided, not when premium is received. Revenue = expected claims + risk adjustment release + CSM release.

ifrs17_annualCohorts.label: IFRS 17: Annual Cohort Grouping
ifrs17_annualCohorts.description: Contracts must be grouped into annual cohorts (issued within one year). Within each cohort, three profitability groups: onerous, no significant risk of becoming onerous, and remaining.

ifrs17_discountRate.label: IFRS 17: Discount Rate
ifrs17_discountRate.description: Two approaches to determining discount rates: bottom-up (risk-free + illiquidity premium) and top-down (asset yield - credit risk). Both should produce equivalent results.

ifrs17_claimsDev.label: IFRS 17: Claims Development
ifrs17_claimsDev.description: Incurred claims lifecycle from event occurrence through reporting, reserving, adjustment, and settlement. The Liability for Incurred Claims (LIC) tracks this.

ifrs17_experienceAdj.label: IFRS 17: Experience Adjustments
ifrs17_experienceAdj.description: Differences between expected and actual cash flows. Premium experience adjustments adjust revenue. Claims experience adjustments adjust the fulfilment cash flows.

ifrs17_presentation.label: IFRS 17: P&L Presentation
ifrs17_presentation.description: How insurance results flow through the income statement: insurance revenue, insurance service expense, insurance finance income/expense.

ifrs17_interimReport.label: IFRS 17: Interim Reporting
ifrs17_interimReport.description: Handling interim (quarterly) vs annual reporting. Interim periods use estimates that may be trued-up at year-end. Locked-in rates and experience adjustments interact differently at interim.

ifrs9_loanModification.label: IFRS 9: Loan Modification
ifrs9_loanModification.description: When loan terms change: assess whether modification is substantial (derecognize and recognize new) or non-substantial (adjust carrying amount). The 10% test on present value of cash flows is the key threshold.

ifrs9_derecognition.label: IFRS 9: Derecognition
ifrs9_derecognition.description: The derecognition decision tree: have contractual rights expired? If not, has the entity transferred substantially all risks and rewards? If ambiguous, has it retained control?

ifrs9_pdModel.label: IFRS 9: PD Model Lifecycle
ifrs9_pdModel.description: Probability of Default model from development through validation, deployment, monitoring, and eventual recalibration or retirement.

ifrs9_forwardLooking.label: IFRS 9: Forward-Looking Overlay
ifrs9_forwardLooking.description: Incorporating forward-looking macroeconomic information into ECL. Define scenarios, assign probabilities, compute scenario-weighted ECL, apply management overlay if needed.

ifrs9_day1PL.label: IFRS 9: Day-1 Profit/Loss
ifrs9_day1PL.description: When fair value at initial recognition differs from transaction price. Day-1 gains are recognized only if fair value is evidenced by observable market data. Otherwise deferred.

ifrs9_poci.label: IFRS 9: POCI Instruments
ifrs9_poci.description: Purchased or originated credit-impaired instruments. These start in Stage 3 equivalent but use credit-adjusted EIR. Only cumulative changes in lifetime ECL after purchase are recognized.

ifrs9_collectiveAssessment.label: IFRS 9: Collective vs Individual
ifrs9_collectiveAssessment.description: Deciding between individual and collective impairment assessment. Large exposures get individual assessment. Homogeneous pools use collective models. Some get both.

ifrs9_scenarioWeighting.label: IFRS 9: Macro Scenario Weighting
ifrs9_scenarioWeighting.description: ECL must reflect probability-weighted outcomes. Typically 3-5 scenarios (base, optimistic, downturn, severe) with expert-assigned probabilities summing to 1.

ifrs9_eirMethod.label: IFRS 9: Effective Interest Rate
ifrs9_eirMethod.description: EIR method: compute rate that discounts future cash flows to carrying amount. Apply each period. Handle modifications by recalculating or using original EIR.

ifrs9_reclassification.label: IFRS 9: Reclassification
ifrs9_reclassification.description: Reclassification between measurement categories is permitted only when the entity changes its business model. Reclassification is applied prospectively from the reclassification date.

ifrs9_financialGuarantee.label: IFRS 9: Financial Guarantee
ifrs9_financialGuarantee.description: Financial guarantee contract lifecycle: initial recognition at fair value, subsequent measurement at higher of ECL provision and amortized premium, through to expiry or payout.

ifrs9_writeoffRecovery.label: IFRS 9: Write-off and Recovery
ifrs9_writeoffRecovery.description: After write-off, the entity may still pursue recovery. Amounts recovered are recognized in P&L. The asset remains derecognized even if partial recovery occurs.

mcmc_hmc.label: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
mcmc_hmc.description: HMC augments the parameter space with momentum variables. Leapfrog integration simulates Hamiltonian dynamics to propose distant points with high acceptance probability.

mcmc_nuts.label: No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS)
mcmc_nuts.description: NUTS automatically tunes the trajectory length in HMC by building a binary tree and stopping when the trajectory starts to double back (U-turn criterion).

mcmc_parallelTempering.label: Parallel Tempering
mcmc_parallelTempering.description: Run multiple chains at different temperatures. Hot chains explore freely, cold chains sample accurately. Periodically swap states between adjacent temperatures based on Metropolis criterion.

mcmc_sliceSampling.label: Slice Sampling
mcmc_sliceSampling.description: Slice sampling introduces an auxiliary variable to define a horizontal slice under the density. Then uniformly samples from the slice. Automatically adapts step size.

mcmc_rjmcmc.label: Reversible Jump MCMC
mcmc_rjmcmc.description: RJMCMC allows moves between models of different dimensionality. Used for model selection where the number of parameters is unknown (e.g., number of mixture components).

mcmc_adaptive.label: Adaptive MCMC
mcmc_adaptive.description: Automatically tunes the proposal distribution during warmup using the sample covariance of accepted points. Adaptation is disabled after warmup to preserve ergodicity.

mcmc_multiChain.label: Multi-Chain Management
mcmc_multiChain.description: Running multiple independent chains, monitoring inter-chain variance (R-hat), and combining results. Chains that diverge are flagged and potentially restarted.

mcmc_thinning.label: MCMC Post-Processing
mcmc_thinning.description: After sampling: discard warmup, thin to reduce autocorrelation, compute summaries, check effective sample size, and store results.

mcmc_ppc.label: Posterior Predictive Check
mcmc_ppc.description: Generate simulated data from the posterior predictive distribution. Compare to observed data using test statistics. Systematic discrepancies indicate model misspecification.

mcmc_smc.label: Sequential Monte Carlo
mcmc_smc.description: Particle filter: maintain a weighted set of particles, update weights as new data arrives, resample when effective sample size drops. Used for online/streaming inference.

mcmc_diagnosticSuite.label: MCMC Diagnostic Suite
mcmc_diagnosticSuite.description: Comprehensive diagnostic workflow: trace plots, autocorrelation, R-hat, ESS, divergence checks, energy diagnostics. Each check can pass or flag issues.

bayes_hierarchical.label: Bayesian Hierarchical Model
bayes_hierarchical.description: Multi-level model: hyperpriors govern group-level parameters, which govern unit-level parameters. Partial pooling emerges naturally. Fit via MCMC or variational inference.

bayes_optimization.label: Bayesian Optimization
bayes_optimization.description: Black-box optimization: fit a Gaussian Process surrogate to observations, maximize an acquisition function (EI, UCB) to select the next evaluation point, observe, update, repeat.

bayes_variational.label: Variational Inference (ELBO)
bayes_variational.description: Approximate the posterior with a simpler distribution by maximizing the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO). Faster than MCMC but introduces approximation error.

bayes_priorElicitation.label: Prior Elicitation
bayes_priorElicitation.description: Structured process for translating expert knowledge into prior distributions. Elicit quantiles, check consistency, fit parametric family, validate with prior predictive simulation.

bayes_clinicalTrial.label: Bayesian Clinical Trial
bayes_clinicalTrial.description: Adaptive Bayesian trial: update treatment effect posterior after each cohort. Allow early stopping for efficacy, futility, or safety. Adjust randomization ratios based on interim data.

bayes_changepoint.label: Bayesian Changepoint Detection
bayes_changepoint.description: Online changepoint detection: maintain run-length posterior. At each observation, either the current regime continues or a changepoint occurred. Compute posterior over changepoint locations.

bayes_networkLearning.label: Bayesian Network Learning
bayes_networkLearning.description: Learning both structure and parameters of a Bayesian network from data. Structure search (score-based or constraint-based), then parameter estimation given the learned DAG.

bayes_empirical.label: Empirical Bayes
bayes_empirical.description: Two-stage estimation: first estimate hyperparameters from the marginal likelihood (the empirical step), then use those as fixed priors for the full Bayesian analysis.

bayes_metaAnalysis.label: Bayesian Meta-Analysis
bayes_metaAnalysis.description: Combining effect sizes from multiple studies. Random-effects model accounts for between-study heterogeneity. The posterior on the overall effect incorporates uncertainty from all sources.

bayes_decisionTheory.label: Bayesian Decision Theory
bayes_decisionTheory.description: Optimal decision-making under uncertainty. Define a loss function, compute posterior expected loss for each action, choose the action minimizing expected loss (Bayes risk).

bayes_timeSeries.label: Bayesian State Space Model
bayes_timeSeries.description: State space model with Bayesian inference: hidden state evolves via transition equation, observations generated via observation equation. Kalman filter (linear) or particle filter (nonlinear).

bayes_nonparametrics.label: Bayesian Nonparametrics (DPM)
bayes_nonparametrics.description: Dirichlet Process Mixture: the number of clusters is inferred from data. New observations can join existing clusters or create new ones. The posterior over partitions is updated via Chinese Restaurant Process or stick-breaking.

bank_otcTrade.label: OTC Derivative Lifecycle
bank_otcTrade.description: Trade lifecycle for OTC derivatives: negotiation, confirmation, clearing, valuation, margin, novation/termination.

bank_kycOnboarding.label: KYC/AML Onboarding
bank_kycOnboarding.description: Institutional client onboarding: identity verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions screening, risk rating, EDD, periodic review.

bank_syndicatedLoan.label: Syndicated Loan Lifecycle
bank_syndicatedLoan.description: Mandate through syndication, commitment, drawdown, servicing, amendment, repayment.

bank_csaMargining.label: ISDA CSA Margining
bank_csaMargining.description: Daily margin cycle: portfolio valuation, exposure calculation, margin call, dispute resolution, collateral transfer.

bank_baselCapital.label: Basel Capital Review
bank_baselCapital.description: ICAAP: risk identification, RWA computation, stress testing, buffer calibration, supervisory review.

bank_corrBanking.label: Correspondent Banking (SWIFT)
bank_corrBanking.description: Cross-border payment via SWIFT: MT103, intermediary processing, nostro/vostro reconciliation, beneficiary credit.

bank_secSettlement.label: Securities Settlement (T+1)
bank_secSettlement.description: Post-trade: matching, affirmation, netting, pre-settlement checks, DVP at CSD, fails management.

bank_creditFacility.label: Credit Facility Drawdown
bank_creditFacility.description: Revolving credit: approval, commitment, drawdown, utilization, covenant testing, renewal/termination.

bank_regReporting.label: Regulatory Report Submission
bank_regReporting.description: CCAR/DFAST/PRA return: data collection, aggregation, validation, attestation, submission, feedback.

bank_structuredProduct.label: Structured Product (CLO/CDO)
bank_structuredProduct.description: Securitization: pooling, tranching, credit enhancement, issuance, waterfall distribution, trigger events, wind-down.

bank_treasuryLiquidity.label: Treasury Liquidity Management
bank_treasuryLiquidity.description: Daily treasury: cash position, intraday monitoring, buffer management, central bank access, LCR/NSFR compliance.

agent_taskLifecycle.label: Agent Task Lifecycle
agent_taskLifecycle.description: Core agent loop: receive, plan, execute tools, observe, reflect, respond. FSM prevents responding before observing tool results.

agent_toolUse.label: Agent Tool Selection
agent_toolUse.description: Function-calling FSM: parse intent, select tool, validate params, execute, handle success/failure. Ensures validation before execution.

agent_multiAgent.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration
agent_multiAgent.description: Supervisor-worker: decompose task, delegate to specialists, collect results, resolve conflicts, synthesize.

agent_rag.label: RAG Pipeline
agent_rag.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: classify, retrieve, evaluate relevance, augment, generate, verify grounding. Prevents hallucination via grounding checks.

agent_hitl.label: Human-in-the-Loop Agent
agent_hitl.description: Agent escalates high-risk decisions to human. FSM guarantees no high-risk action executes without sign-off.

agent_memory.label: Agent Memory Management
agent_memory.description: Working memory: buffer, summarize when full, promote to long-term, evict stale, retrieve on demand.

agent_guardrails.label: Agent Guardrails
agent_guardrails.description: Safety layer: content filter, policy check, PII scan, toxicity scoring. Violations trigger fallback.

agent_planning.label: Agent Plan-and-Execute
agent_planning.description: Separate planning from execution: generate plan, validate, execute steps, monitor, re-plan on failure.

agent_eval.label: Agent Evaluation Loop
agent_eval.description: Continuous evaluation: run test suite, score, compare baseline, promote or rollback. Prevents deploying regressed agents.

agent_codeGen.label: Agentic Code Generation
agent_codeGen.description: Code agent: spec, generate, test, fix, lint, review. FSM prevents merging untested code.

agent_errorRecovery.label: Agent Error Recovery
agent_errorRecovery.description: Classify error, apply strategy (retry/fallback/escalate), track attempts, circuit-break on repeated failures.

agent_scopeAuth.label: Agent Scope and Authorization
agent_scopeAuth.description: Permission management: request capability, check scope, grant/deny, audit usage, revoke on violation. Prevents privilege escalation.

agent_contextWindow.label: Agent Context Window Mgmt
agent_contextWindow.description: Token budget: track usage, truncate/summarize near limit, prioritize recent context, handle overflow.

lloyds_syndicateCycle.label: Syndicate Capacity Cycle
lloyds_syndicateCycle.description: Annual cycle: business plan, Lloyd's approval, stamp allocation, YOA open, monitoring, RITC or run-off at 36 months.

lloyds_placing.label: Lloyd's Placing/Binding
lloyds_placing.description: Risk placement: broker prepares slip, lead quotes, following market subscribes, sign-down if oversubscribed, contract certain.

lloyds_claim.label: Lloyd's Claim Lifecycle
lloyds_claim.description: Claim at Lloyd's: notification, lead adjuster, agreement parties, ECF processing, bureau settlement, recovery.

lloyds_coverholder.label: Lloyd's Delegated Authority
lloyds_coverholder.description: Coverholder lifecycle: application, approval, binder, bordereaux reporting, performance monitoring, renewal/termination.

lloyds_outwardRI.label: Lloyd's Outward Reinsurance
lloyds_outwardRI.description: Syndicate purchasing reinsurance: programme design, placement, inception, claims recovery, commutation/expiry.

lloyds_capitalCall.label: Funds at Lloyd's (FAL)
lloyds_capitalCall.description: Capital provision: FAL provided, annual adequacy test, cash call on deficiency, surplus release.

lloyds_solvency.label: Lloyd's Regulatory Reporting
lloyds_solvency.description: Syndicate SCR computation, internal model, aggregate to Lloyd's, PRA submission, member-level reporting.
